full_lines.heard: Landing in Kingston, here are three ways to get to your hotel.
The airport sits on the Palaisado's peninsula beside the harbor, about 20 minutes from downtown Kingston.
One a pre-booked private transfer, so your driver is arranged before you land.
to an approved taxi. The UK advises Jamaican tourist board taxis with a blue JTB sticker.
Three, a rental car, Jamaica drives on the left.
Compare partner transfers through the link in the description. If you book through our links, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.
